visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and a black baseball cap, wearing a plain white t-shirt, walks through a modern office environment. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and active hand gestures. (2) He stops in front of a miniature Häagen-Dazs branded ice cream booth, which sits on a white counter. The background shows a lounge area with grey sofas. (3) The man opens a white freezer door, revealing rows of neatly stacked Häagen-Dazs ice cream boxes. He gestures towards them with an excited expression. (4) He approaches a female colleague sitting at a desk with a laptop; she has short black hair and wears a white shirt. He hands her an ice cream box. (5) He interacts with another female colleague with curly hair in a striped shirt near the ice cream booth. (6) The man presents an ice cream bar directly to the camera, holding it up against the office background. (7) A close-up shot shows him biting into the chocolate-covered ice cream bar, looking satisfied. (8) Two female colleagues are seen sitting together, each holding an ice cream bar and smiling warmly at the camera. (9) Various close-up shots show the ice cream bars on a wooden tray, some in boxes and some unwrapped, showing the nutty chocolate texture and the vanilla-cookie interior. (10) The man stands alone by the freezer again, looking at the rows of ice cream with a humorous, contemplative expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To endorse the Häagen-Dazs ice cream bars by presenting them as a positive, fun reward for office work, highlighting the product's improved texture and flavor while leveraging the creator's approachable and humorous persona.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of partnership with Häagen-Dazs, focused showcase of the branded miniature booth and freezer, and close-ups detailing product upgrades.
